title: TileMap editor tab switches to TileSet tab when clicking on tile source after scrolling
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5.stable, v4.6.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Steam Runtime 2 (soldier) 2 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-10850K CPU @ 3.60GHz (20 threads) - 31.19 GiB memory

### Issue description

In the TileMap tab of the editor, double clicking on a tile source will open it in the TileSet tab. However, this behavior can be triggered by scrolling then clicking a tile source. It would appear as though scrolling is treated as clicking, which therefore means that left clicking shortly after scrolling is treated as a double click. If you wait too long (roughly one second) after scrolling, the TileSet tab is not opened, and the intended behavior of opening the tile source in the TileMap tab happens instead.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/326f8b44-e2cc-45f8-a80c-ae293142071e)

It should be noted that I have three tile sources in the example GIF to better illustrate scrolling, however only a single tile source is required for the bug. The movement of the mouse wheel is what matters.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Have a TileMap node with it's TileSet property set to a TileSet with at least one tile source defined.
2. Open the TileMap tab in the editor and navigate to the "Tiles" subtab
3. Hover over a tile source, then scroll
4. Quickly left click on the tile source after scrolling
5. The TileSet tab will open for the chosen tile source instead of the TileMap tab

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[tilemap-tab-switching-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25029295/tilemap-tab-switching-bug.zip)
